description: Calculates the real-world travel distance and time between two or more places, walking, driving or cycling, on OpenStreetMap data. Waypoints are visited in the given order. Set include_steps for a turn-by-turn summary. Use route_matrix to compare many pairs, optimize_route to reorder stops.

include_steps.description: Include a turn-by-turn step summary, default false

language.description: Language for resolved place labels, default "en"

profile.description: Travel mode: on foot, by car or by bicycle

waypoints.description: Start, optional stops in between, destination

items.description: Place name, address, or coordinates as "lat,lon"

name: route

via.description: The road the leg mostly follows, where the engine names one.

steps.description: Only with include_steps. Instructions are OSM street names.

title: Route between places
